name: AIIcon
description: AIIcon is the canonical way to render any icon on a ZAIDYN AI surface. The icon set itself is the Zaidyn Icon Library — the same `ui-icon-{name}` inventory documented in Foundations → Iconography, whe
intent: Not a new icon set — a behavior and color layer applied to standard icons. Every AI icon choice must justify its treatment against the 60-30-10 color rule: 60% neutral, 30% product/semantic, 10% AI identity.

authority.note: Imported from godesign27/agentic-ui-design-system (branch cursor/import-ai-components-6d77). Runtime TSX lives under src/components/ai/. Existing top-level shadcn ports remain authoritative for the governed AI kit.

props.name: size
props.hint: xs=12px (inline metadata) · sm=16px Standard normal (default for most contexts) · md=20px Standard large (standard AI icon) · lg=24px Standard x-large (prominent AI identity) · xl=32px (hero / empty states only)

props.name: container
props.hint: Render icon in a rounded-square container background

props.name: label
props.hint: Accessible label. Required for non-decorative standalone icons.

props.name: decorative
props.hint: Mark icon as aria-hidden (paired with visible text label)

props.name: motionLoop
props.hint: Loop motion indefinitely (only appropriate for active progress states)

props.name: style
props.hint: Inline style override applied to outermost element

forbiddenUsage: Do not use AI identity treatment on every icon on the surface
Do not use Signal orange for standard AI output icons — only escalation / stale
Do not loop attention animations (pulse, nudge) indefinitely
Do not use motion as the only indicator of state change
Do not create custom icon shapes outside ICON_PATHS
Do not use spin for decorative AI presence — use pulse instead
